title: Unlocking the Duality between Flow and Field Matching
abstract: arXiv:2602.02261v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) unifies conventional generative paradigms such as diffusion and flow-based models. Interaction Field Matching (IFM) is a recently proposed framework that generalizes Electrostatic Field Matching (EFM), rooted in Poisson Flow Generative Models (PFGM). While both frameworks define generative dynamics, they start from different objects: CFM specifies a conditional probability path in data space, whereas IFM specifies a physics-inspired interaction field in an augmented data space. This raises a basic question: are CFM and IFM genuinely different, or are they two descriptions of the same underlying dynamics? We show that they coincide for a natural subclass of IFM, which we call forward-only IFM. Specifically, we give explicit constructions in both directions and show that CFM and forward-only IFM induce the same family of data-space dynamics. General IFM, however, is strictly more expressive: already in E

translated_title: 解锁流匹配与场匹配之间的对偶性
translated_abstract: 条件流匹配统一了诸如扩散模型和基于流的模型等传统生成范式。交互场匹配是最近提出的一个框架，它推广了根植于泊松流生成模型（PFGM）的静电场匹配（EFM）。尽管这两个框架都定义了生成动力学，但它们的出发点不同：CFM 在数据空间中指定一条条件概率路径，而 IFM 在增广数据空间中指定一个受物理启发的交互场。这引出了一个基本问题：CFM 和 IFM 究竟是真正不同的方法，还是同一底层动力学的两种描述？我们证明，对于 IFM 的一个自然子类——我们称之为“仅前向 IFM”（forward-only IFM）——二者是完全一致的。具体而言，我们在两个方向上给出了显式构造，并证明 CFM 与仅前向 IFM 诱导出相同的数据空间动力学族。然而，一般的 IFM 表达能力严格更强：甚至在 E（原文摘要至此处被截断）
tldr: 本文证明了条件流匹配（CFM）与仅前向交互场匹配在数据空间动力学上完全等价（并给出双向显式构造），而一般形式的交互场匹配则具有严格更强的表达能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) and forward-only Interaction Field Matching induce the same family of data-space dynamics through explicit constructions in both directions, while general IFM is strictly more expressive.
